name: La Fregeneda (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, white above and below and red at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Fregeneda (trees on blue and a castle on green above waves).
history: The arms of La Fregeneda were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 10 May 1997; the municipal flag was approved on 30 March 2009 and is quartered per saltire, gules and argent, charged with the crowned municipal arms.
